name: Guimbal Cabri G2 collective with throttle grip
view: the collective lever from the right, as the pilot sees it at the left hip; forward is right: the lever with the twist-grip throttle at its end, the governor switch and the starter push button on the throttle grip
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the lever, the throttle grip and the control layout reconstructed from the public Cabri G2 descriptions (Guimbal Cabri G2 overview, the MSFS Cabri G2 documentation, Wikipedia) and public photos looked at for proportions; the exact positions of the switch and the button on the grip are not confirmed. Not traced from a photo.
